tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get a person's verified professional profile - headline, summary, employment history with highlights, skills and education - from their Tazilo profile URL or handle. Returns markdown.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask one short factual question about a person's professional background - e.g. their leadership experience, a launch they shipped or the tools they use - by Tazilo profile URL or handle. Answers come only from what they published.
